description: Start here before you make a 3D model for a three.js scene: what the thing is (English or Dutch, typos and descriptions work), the nearest ready-made kind to start from, its parts and real size, the rules and usual mistakes, the order of tools and a spec cheat sheet. glTF and three.js agree: +Y up, metres, the model's front is +Z. Read-only.
name: three_model_brief
title: One page before you build a model
